Home / Enrichments

Shomoukh Ateliers & Enrichments

Smart & innovative learning environments where children research, sculpt, paint, and explore their hundred languages.

INNOVATIVE SPACES

The Shomoukh Fun Space

Shomoukh ateliers are not just art corners, but laboratories of research where children experiment with different media under the mentorship of our specialized Atelieristas.

RESEARCH ATELIER

Clay Atelier

Children experiment with natural clay—a soft, responsive medium that can be shaped by hand gestures or sculpting tools, fostering 3D spatial thinking and fine motor skills.

View Atelier Details
EXPRESSION ATELIER

Art Atelier

Children have access to stimulating artistic materials and are encouraged to use multiple symbolic languages—natural dyes, paints, charcoal, and organic papers—to express themselves.

View Atelier Details
INNOVATION ATELIER

Digital & Light Atelier

Children use light in different forms alongside analog and digital tools to investigate reflections, shadows, logic, and early digital literacy through collaborative inquiry.

View Atelier Details
